_about: Public-domain Alexander Hamilton Vinton (1807-1881), Episcopal rector of St. Paul's, Boston, and Holy Trinity, Philadelphia, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons (1855), his farewell sermon at St. Paul's, his Civil War fast and thanksgiving sermons (1860-1865), and Four Lectures delivered at Holy Trinity in 1877. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 90 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

vinton-farewell: A farewell sermon preached at St. Paul's Church, Boston, October 3, 1858 (Boston : James B. Dow, Office of the Christian Witness and Church Advocate, 1858)
vinton-christian-watchman: The Christian watchman : a sermon, preached in St. Paul's Church, Boston, January 11, 1860, at the institution of the Rev. William R. Nicholson, D.D (Boston : James B. Dow, 1860)
vinton-thanksgiving-1860: Thanksgiving sermon / by Alexander H. Vinton ; November 29, 1860 (Protestant Episcopal Book Society, 1860)
vinton-god-in-government: God in government. A sermon: preached on the day of the national fast, January 4, 1861, in the Church of the Holy Trinity, Philadelphia / by Alexander H. Vinton (Philadelphia : Protestant Episcopal Book Society, 1861)
vinton-mans-rule: Man's rule and Christ's reign. A sermon, preached on Thanksgiving Day, November 27th, 1862 (New-York, J. A. Gray, printer, 1862)
vinton-thanksgiving-1863: A sermon, preached on the national Thanksgiving day, November 26th, 1863 (New-York, G. F. Nesbitt & co., printers, 1863)
vinton-thanksgiving-1864: Cause for thanksgiving : a sermon, preached on the national thanksgiving day, November 24th, 1864 (New-York : John A. Gray & Green, printers, stereotypers, and binders, 1864)
vinton-duties-of-peace: The duties of peace : the nation's third thanksgiving, a sermon preached in St. Mark's Church in the Bowerie, on December 7, 1865 / by the Rev. Alexander H. Vinton (J.A. Gray & Green, 1865)
vinton-four-lectures: Four lectures delivered in the Church of the Holy Trinity, Philadelphia, in the year 1877, on the foundation of the late John Bohlen, esq (New York, T. Whittaker, 1887)

_excluded.vinton-1909: Addresses (1909), a memorial service shared with William Lawrence
